title: Claude Max Credits
author: DrDarhk
selftext: Like others I have the max plan for Claude and I’m not sure what to use the $200 monthly API credit for. Was looking to see if anyone here uses them and what they use them for.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: The same thing you do normally, just on your command line. Its the same tool, just a different interface.

replies.author: DrDarhk
replies.body: So i could use it to keep building the game? I thought it was just for API usage like a chatbot or something lol

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Depending on your technical skills, on your computer, use you command line to go the folder where you game is, type 'claude'. It boots up and your prompt away like normal, just on your command line console.

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body: Claude works on the command line without this. I use Claude like 99% from the command-line, and it doesn’t use any API credits.

comments.author: Zealousideal-Bug1837
comments.body: get an API key from the console, configure local Claude with it, or PI harness etc etc.

comments.author: Somnati
comments.body: im using it to build my own custom 3d game engine

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body:
It's for writing programs that use AI. Like, maybe you want your own chatbot, or you want to have it constantly looking at your logs / analytics, etc.

The subscription is for you (human) to use Claude. The API credits are for your computer to use Claude without you.

replies.author: DrDarhk
replies.body: Ahhh okay okay thank you for the simple explanation!

comments.author: Limp_Bus3865
comments.body: I make my own apps, games and use it for work.

comments.author: glimsky
comments.body: Did you know you can downgrade to the $20 plan if you want to?
